name: Delinquent-kun
source:
"What? No way. It's a pain in the ass."

Sometimes rude, gruff, and not honest with himself, it is a little difficult to know what he really thinks. But behind this "bad boy" behavior actually hides a clumsy, shy guy.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31367]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
